onboarding.note: Identity comes from the enclosing git worktree: origin remote, HEAD revision and the git ls-tree digest of the skill root at that revision. No external pin is possible or needed, because git itself is the record.

999.note: Pinned revision. The tree digest is null until the pinned checkout is provisioned and its bytes are measured; while it is null, a tree placed at the pin path is REFUSED rather than accepted on its name alone. Fill this from the provisioned tree before any 999 release claim.
